description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of unit tests for verifying the behavior of git submodule 'is-active' checks using a testing framework and the 'test-tool'. It sets up git repositories and submodules, manipulates configurations, and asserts expected outcomes for different scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs provided commands, and reports pass/fail.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the executed command fails.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output of commands or files for equality.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified directory with a message.
